verdict.rationale: The evidence notes that a GraphQL API lives at developer.waveapps.com, but that portal returned 403 and none of its documentation could be quoted. Nothing in the pack shows API access to the general ledger or trial balance, or any open-format export of them. The documented reports cover only P&L, balance sheet and cash flow in the UI, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.
